[[Verdarach]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] [[warhorn]] crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]]. 

== Lore ==
{{Legendary unlock text|When Grenth's powers were raw and new, he crafted a weapon more sinister than he intended. Verdarach summons victims of horrific battles as vengeful wraiths, eager to conscript the newly slain.}}
{{quotation|[https://www.guildwars2.com/en/the-game/releases/June-26-2018/ Official website]|Long ago, when [[Grenth]]’s powers were raw and new, he created a weapon more potent—and more sinister—than he ever intended. The warhorn Verdarach calls upon the [[ghost|spirits]] of those who died in horrific battles and summons them as vengeful wraiths. When the horn fades back into the [[Underworld]] after combat, its grisly attendants grasp for the souls of the newly slain, eager to conscript them into their ranks.}}

== Graphics ==
[[Verdarach]] is a large, ghostly warhorn that is translucent when stowed, but becomes opaque when wielded.

;Aura	
* The user's body is coated in a ghostly fog.

;Draw/Stow effects
* When drawn, the warhorn grows in size, and becomes opaque.  White mist flows in the direction the user is facing, and ethereal ghosts rush forward from behind the player.
* When stowed, the warhorn shrinks back, and becomes translucent again.

; Footfalls
* The user leaves behind patches of mist that clear away to reveal a shadowy claw mark on the ground.

; Skill effects
* Mist erupts from the horn for most warhorn skills.
* Plays a deep note of random pitch for all warhorn skills.
* {{Tempest}} [[Tempest]]: [[Water Globe]], [[Cyclone]] and [[Lightning Orb]] projectiles are followed by a flying ghost.

== Trivia ==
* Verdarach was released with [[Living World Season 4]] Episode 3, [[Long Live the Lich]].
* The designs on Verdarach bear similarities to the pillars of robed figures found throughout the [[Crystal Desert]] and [[Elona]] in both games, especially with the appearance of figures in the [[Lair of the Forgotten]].
* Players who have unlocked [[Verdarach (skin)|Verdarach's skin]] automatically receive the [[Musical Verdarach]] novelty. Players who have unlocked Verdarach's skin previously but don't have the instrument are able to purchase it from [[Sarettokk]].
